scope: design audit plus native runtime implementation; remaining comparison controls are not claimed implemented

blockers.why: Current setup, preflight, scorer and runner use a container wrapper. Official EvalPlus already supports native Python.
blockers.acceptance: Implement and inspect a native Conda path, explicit interpreter/environment fingerprint, process/deadline cleanup; replay unchanged official scorer on sourced native canonical cases and retained native model outputs; retain real host execution/isolation capability. No container dependency.

blockers.why: No GPU baseline observations or current qualified Parent/Natural Gate 0/IPCG closure.
blockers.acceptance: Collect native baseline/natural failure evidence and strongest-simple contrasts, join closest-work audit, then freeze current parent/value/importance artifacts. No retroactive validation of historical prototype.

blockers.why: No measured target-host time, current VRAM/allocation or consumed eight-hour budget.
blockers.acceptance: Retain one-device telemetry, representative generation/training/reference-forward/scoring/save costs; budget complete comparisons using measured bounds and remaining authorization.

blockers.why: lower_lr uses hard labels.
blockers.acceptance: Add full-soft low-LR and controlled LR variants with same optimizer/targets; check semantic objective identity and cost accounting.

blockers.why: fixed_alpha/fresh_alpha contain one-hot labels.
blockers.acceptance: Implement deterministic q=(1-a)p+a*mu separately; keep hard-mixture controls available under their real names.

blockers.why: Mass transfer and conditional head reshaping are not separated.
blockers.acceptance: Four conditions on identical support/prefixes: identity; head reshape at unchanged mass; mass transfer with original within-support shape; both. Native metrics + matched information.

blockers.why: Geometric/ratio methods include epsilon smoothing absent from original arithmetic control.
blockers.acceptance: Arithmetic and boundary controls use the exact same m=(1-epsilon)mu+epsilon*p0 and reference forwards.

blockers.why: No exact-head+iid-tail comparator for stratification.
blockers.acceptance: Same head/draw counts/expected target and measured total cost; no claimed sparse speedup for dense code.

blockers.why: Lag benefit is confounded with weaker updates and extra forwards.
blockers.acceptance: Current-current duplicate, lag-only and full-soft lower-LR controls; verify R1 degeneracy and R2/R3 differences.

blockers.why: Position-specific gating needs a matched constant gate.
blockers.acceptance: Use each frozen prefix batch's deterministic mean gate and the same soft references; independent RNG/source identities retained.

blockers.why: Prefix weighting needs a same-average loss scale control.
blockers.acceptance: Uniform weight equal to frozen sequence's mean weight; separately compare lower LR because Adam does not make the two exactly equivalent.

blockers.why: Fixed alpha=0.5 does not match an adaptive quadratic noise budget.
blockers.acceptance: Compute common constant a=min(1,sqrt(B/sum G(mu))) after prefixes fixed, then draw independent fresh labels; bind exact budget/draw count.

blockers.why: Only full_soft_sgd exists; AdamW differences would confound M12.
blockers.acceptance: SGD arithmetic anchor and same-norm SGD shrinkage; report projection and finite-step KL without global guarantees.

blockers.why: Same steps/samples are not equal cost when extra forwards or rejections are used.
blockers.acceptance: Separate matched-information/data runs from equal-training-wall-clock runs; freeze checkpoint selection by elapsed cost, never held-out score; keep evaluation budget equal.

blockers.why: Prompt allocation changes multiplicity and may change implicit objective.
blockers.acceptance: Uniform weighted control and uncorrected-weight ablation; preserve total sample count and log all per-prompt counts/proxy forwards.

blockers.why: Generation mixture versus target anchoring lacks complete interaction controls.
blockers.acceptance: Generation mixture on/off × anchor soft target on/off, zero-mixture boundary and cost match. Keep these as controls, not new candidate ideas.

blockers.why: Fixed truncation cannot test the untruncated temperature-composition identity.
blockers.acceptance: Explicit condition-specific run configs for untruncated and truncated comparisons, and once-only temperature versus distributed schedule. Different conditions cannot share incompatible controls.

blockers.why: Head smoothing may reduce to a simpler temperature setting.
blockers.acceptance: Developer-only matching of global-temperature control, same support rule and fair selection cost, then freeze before confirmation.

blockers.why: Defaults do not establish competitive strongest baselines.
blockers.acceptance: Dev-only bounded tuning with at most three values per named uncertain scalar and equal tuning time for candidate/strong baseline; all tries retained; no blind grid or confirmation feedback.

blockers.why: Current report has one-seed task bootstrap only.
blockers.acceptance: Implement/review frozen crossed task/seed analysis and family correction with live callback; retain official native metric outputs and complete arm inventories. Missing/degenerate evidence stays INCONCLUSIVE.

blockers.why: Closest-method reading has not been converted to runnable matched losses/rollouts.
blockers.acceptance: Same-information smoothed FKL/RKL/JSD × round/per-update rollout factors with equal generation allowance; verify causal masks/teacher detach/zero-gradient identity and official output scoring.

blockers.why: Current data/runner is HumanEval-dev only.
blockers.acceptance: Native MBPP+ support, explicit confirmation split, exact official prompt/extraction/input conversion; LCB external runner uses frozen data revision and official custom evaluator with task-ID validation.

blockers.why: Narrative v2 design is not a frozen native protocol.
blockers.acceptance: After required source/host/baseline/control qualification, bind exact refs, per-arm information/budget, released manifests, native scorer, analysis, code-stage discovery batch and current parent, then freeze child protocol and derive design_verified.
